themes.theme: Public Equity vs. Private Equity Liquidity

positions.commentary: The speaker suggests that investors might prefer putting money in Apple or Microsoft rather than being trapped in private equity deals with liquidity problems.
The speaker suggests that putting money in Microsoft is preferable to having it trapped in private equity deals that might not go bankrupt but also won't return capital quickly.
